consequence.statement: Existing ServiceMonitor resources continue to function; the new optional field allows explicit control over service discovery role when needed.

original.statement: ServiceMonitor v1 schema adds optional field spec.serviceDiscoveryRole to explicitly set the service discovery role (Endpoints or EndpointSlice) for target discovery, defaulting to the value in the referenced Prometheus/PrometheusAgent resource if unset.

decision.reason: [ev-557f479305b6] shows spec.serviceDiscoveryRole added to the ServiceMonitor v1 schema between 0.85.0 and 0.86.2 as an optional enum (Endpoints/EndpointSlice). When unset, it "defaults to the value defined in the Prometheus/PrometheusAgent resource", so existing ServiceMonitors keep their current discovery behaviour. No evidence says anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated. The canonical validator confirmed added/none, so the consequence "none" (informational) is supported.
